title: Five canonical families versus latent correlation fields versus 42 hyperforms

shadow_hypotheses.statement: The five canonical family labels are not associated with unsupervised correlation clusters beyond chance.
The five canonical family labels show reproducible association with latent correlation clusters under label-blind analysis.
The 42-hyperform graph does not mediate or improve the association between family labels and correlation structure beyond chance.
The 42-hyperform graph provides reproducible structural information linking family labels to correlation structure.

required_tests: recover raw 100x100 numeric matrix and immutable index-to-formula mapping
estimate cluster count without forcing k=5
compute ARI and NMI only after independent cluster estimation
run permutation test with family labels shuffled
recover 42-node adjacency/edge list and compute graph communities/modularity
test whether hyperform-derived features improve held-out family/cluster association
notes: Five canonical RAFAELIA families and five candidate correlation fields are distinct objects until independently linked. The 42-hyperform visualization is not treated as an adjacency matrix or empirical cosmology result.
